scripts.build: cd packages/telemetry && npm run build && cd ../schema && npm run build && cd ../tui && npm run build && cd ../mcp && npm run build && cd ../ai && npm run build:offline && cd ../agent && npm run build && cd ../coding-agent && npm run build:unbundled
scripts.coverage: SCRIPTC_EMIT_WORKERS=1 taskpolicy -c utility scriptc coverage --coverage=reached packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts && (pkill -f 'tsc-ts --api' || true) && (pkill -f 'scriptc-llvm-codegen serve' || true)
scripts.build:native: (pkill -f 'tsc-ts --api' || true) && (pkill -f 'scriptc-llvm-codegen serve' || true) && SCRIPTC_EMIT_WORKERS=1 taskpolicy -c utility scriptc build --optimization=dev --strip --no-keep-llvm --no-shape-overlay packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts -o dist/pi && rm -rf dist/pi.dSYM dist/pi.libnode dist/*.ll && (pkill -f 'tsc-ts --api' || true) && (pkill -f 'scriptc-llvm-codegen serve' || true)
scripts.build:native:dist: (pkill -f 'tsc-ts --api' || true) && (pkill -f 'scriptc-llvm-codegen serve' || true) && SCRIPTC_EMIT_WORKERS=1 taskpolicy -c utility scriptc build --optimization=dev --strip --no-keep-llvm --no-shape-overlay --libnode=beside packages/coding-agent/src/cli.ts -o dist/pi && rm -rf dist/pi.dSYM dist/*.ll && (pkill -f 'tsc-ts --api' || true) && (pkill -f 'scriptc-llvm-codegen serve' || true)
scripts.build:gui: (pkill -f 'tsc-ts --api' || true) && (pkill -f 'scriptc-llvm-codegen serve' || true) && SCRIPTC_EMIT_WORKERS=1 taskpolicy -c utility scriptc build --optimization=dev --strip --no-keep-llvm --no-shape-overlay packages/coding-agent/src/gui-cli.ts --ffi packages/gui/ffi/darwin.json -o dist/pi-gui && rm -rf dist/pi-gui.dSYM dist/pi-gui.libnode dist/*.ll && (pkill -f 'tsc-ts --api' || true) && (pkill -f 'scriptc-llvm-codegen serve' || true)
scripts.build:gui:dist: (pkill -f 'tsc-ts --api' || true) && (pkill -f 'scriptc-llvm-codegen serve' || true) && SCRIPTC_EMIT_WORKERS=1 taskpolicy -c utility scriptc build --optimization=dev --strip --no-keep-llvm --no-shape-overlay --libnode=beside packages/coding-agent/src/gui-cli.ts --ffi packages/gui/ffi/darwin.json -o dist/pi-gui && rm -rf dist/pi-gui.dSYM dist/*.ll && (pkill -f 'tsc-ts --api' || true) && (pkill -f 'scriptc-llvm-codegen serve' || true)
scripts.build:examples: for f in counter tasks desktop bench demo hopper gallery; do SCRIPTC_EMIT_WORKERS=1 taskpolicy -c utility scriptc build --optimization=dev --strip --no-keep-llvm --no-shape-overlay packages/gui/examples/$f.ts --ffi packages/gui/ffi/darwin.json -o dist/examples/$f || exit 1; done && rm -rf dist/examples/*.dSYM dist/examples/*.ll && (pkill -f 'tsc-ts --api' || true) && (pkill -f 'scriptc-llvm-codegen serve' || true)
